name: ApexAir Travel WebMCP Tools
description: WebMCP travel tools for Gemini in Chrome to inspect flight details and authenticate bookings with passkeys.

tools.name: get_account_status
tools.description: Checks whether the user is currently signed into their ApexAir account.

tools.name: login_with_passkey
tools.description: Triggers WebAuthn Immediate UI Mode to authenticate the user with their saved passkey in 1 tap without passwords.

tools.name: confirm_booking
tools.description: Authenticates and finalizes the flight reservation for ApexAir Flight AA-482.
